reuse.why: Ignores the existing notes table (DbNote, keyed by group id) and adds a new category_groups.notes column via migration; no shared category selection is introduced, so each action keeps its own query.

duplication.why: The same category-selection SQL (hidden flag switch, #fixed LIKE, goal_def IS NULL) is pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg, with a JS version in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Actions stay in budget/actions.ts, but group notes are moved into a new schema column instead of the notes store the tree uses, and the rule is spread across each action instead of one selection helper.

scope.why: A schema migration and a DbCategoryGroup type change are added that the requests do not need, since group notes already exist.

maintainability.why: Every future change to which categories month-wide actions touch must be made in six places in two languages, and the #fixed tag reads a column the app never writes, diverging from where users' notes live.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Migration 1791849600000_add_category_group_notes.sql and g.notes reads bypass the existing notes table; every month-wide action builds its own category query instead of a shared selection.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth restates the SQL rule as JS guards (group_notes?.includes('#fixed'), goal_def != null, hidden check), a reshaped copy of the WHERE clause pasted into the five other actions.

abstraction_drift.where: No shared selection exists or is created: setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg each re-implement the selection SQL and copyPreviousMonth re-implements it in JS, with includeHiddenCategories threaded separately through each.
